summary: Privacy overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 privacy pytest passing — venue is 403 on /gallery, /gallery/{slug}/messages, /gallery/{slug}/download, /files/{id}; venue is 200 on /weddings/{slug} and /weddings/{slug}/qr. Couple (aria.leo) is 200 on all media endpoints and sees 5 photos + messages. Admin allowed. /auth/set-password enforces >=6 chars and requires auth. Frontend: couple login lands on /my-gallery, shows 5 photos, guestbook tab, couple-slideshow-btn + account-password-btn present, set-password-form dialog opens with new-password/confirm-password/save-password testids. Venue on /dashboard/wedding/cec8f84007 shows privacy-panel (no gallery), memory count '5 memories collected so far', QR + Invite buttons, and NO slideshow button. Venue navigating to /slideshow/cec8f84007 is redirected to /dashboard. First-time invite E2E: /invite/{token} in fresh context redirects to /my-gallery, auto-opens create-password dialog, saving a password (>=6) succeeds, and the couple can then sign in at /login with email+password.
critical_code_review_comments: _can_access_wedding() is cleanly restricted to admin + owning couple — venue explicitly excluded. Good.
/api/files/{id} and /api/gallery/{slug}/download both re-authenticate manually (header/query/cookie) and then call _can_access_wedding — consistent and enforces privacy on media URLs used by too.
/api/auth/set-password enforces min-6 and updates password_set=true; user_public() now surfaces password_set so the frontend can auto-prompt first-time couples.
InviteAccept.js correctly navigates to /my-gallery which then checks password_set on /auth/me to auto-open the create-password modal — verified working end-to-end.
Slideshow route restricted to couple+admin at the router level in App.js — venue is bounced back to /dashboard as observed.
Prior iteration_2 issue (login lockout / upload rate-limit using request.client.host under K8s ingress) is unrelated to this change but still open — not re-tested here.
